37/G.goal: Explain how contextual inquiry can be used to gather usability requirements for an XR system by identifying user groups and challenges and converting findings into design guidelines and functional requirements.
37/G.achieves: It gives the learner a structured basis for deriving implementable XR system requirements from real user context in the system development life cycle.

37/O1.goal: Explain how contextual inquiry findings can be turned into documented usability requirements, from design guidelines to a functional requirements hierarchy.
37/O1.achieves: It lets the learner move from observed user context to structured, implementable requirements for an XR system.

37/O2.goal: Describe how contextual inquiry can be applied to the Majuli VR Tour to identify user groups and usability challenges.
37/O2.achieves: It grounds requirement gathering in a concrete XR case study, preparing the learner to connect real user needs to later design decisions.
